summary: This specification extends Proxy Mobile IPv6 so a mobile router can obtain IP prefixes for its attached mobile networks using DHCPv6 prefix delegation. The network provides mobility support for those prefixes, as it does for other addresses.

eli5.summary: A moving train needs a block of addresses for all the devices on board. This explains how the network hands the train a block and keeps it working as the train moves.

questions: mobile router dhcpv6-pd proxy mobile ipv6
